title: discern CLI and MCP JSON results
description: The public JSON contract for discern CLI --json results and MCP tool results. Runtime schemas remain strict, but this published schema intentionally permits additive object fields so older pinned schemas can validate newer compatible output.

items.description: One checkpoint question the agent declared met, with the declaration time. Agent evidence: recorded, not machine-verified.
One checkpoint question the agent declared unmet, with its rationale and declaration time. Landing requires an owner-authorized variance.

name.description: The issuer's asserted display name. A verified signature protects this text from alteration; trust policy decides who the signing key represents.

email.description: The issuer's asserted email address. A verified signature protects this text from alteration; trust policy decides who the signing key represents.

key.description: The issuer's asserted key or key reference. Verifiers use their signing profile and trust policy rather than trusting this value on its own.

issuer.description: Identity details asserted by the proof payload. A verified Dead Simple Signing Envelope (DSSE) signature protects these details from alteration but does not establish who controls the signing key. Current writers leave them absent.

DiscernProof.title: DiscernProof
DiscernProof.description: The structured proof a green gate emits over a clean committed tree: the branch, trunk, validated commit (abbreviated for display), whole-diff stats, and the two renderings derived from those facts.

DiscernProofCheckpoints.title: DiscernProofCheckpoints

items.description: One checkpoint question the agent declared met, with the declaration time. Agent evidence: recorded, not machine-verified.
One checkpoint question the agent declared unmet, with its rationale and declaration time. Landing requires an owner-authorized variance.

DiscernProofCheckpoints.description: Agent-declared checkpoint conclusions carried by the Proof, separate from machine results: the governing policy identity, the declared-met set, and the declared-unmet set whose landing still requires owner-authorized variances.

DiscernProofSummary.title: DiscernProofSummary
DiscernProofSummary.description: The compact Proof claim: branch, trunk, validated commit, whole-diff statistics, and the one-line rendered proof.

DiscernAuthorizedVariance.title: DiscernAuthorizedVariance
DiscernAuthorizedVariance.description: Owner authorization to land one declared-unmet checkpoint, bound to the exact declaration (checkpoint, definition hash, subject fingerprint, rationale) and the commit it landed with. Never a future policy.

DiscernCliJsonResult.title: DiscernCliJsonResult
DiscernCliJsonResult.description: Any `discern <command> --json` result. Consumers with a known verb should prefer the per-verb schema referenced by x-discern-contracts for clearer validation errors.

DiscernMcpJsonResult.title: DiscernMcpJsonResult
DiscernMcpJsonResult.description: Any MCP tool result object returned by discern's MCP server. Its structuredContent is the same DiscernResult envelope exposed by the corresponding CLI command; content carries an independently sufficient authored Markdown projection.
